steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Yawn)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Fold the blankets into dougan, and that'll do.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Wallet, keys, jacket...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'll... leave the comms gear.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Shield... leave that too. You rest easy for today, partner.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'll kick these for shoes. Mmm. Nope, don't feel it. Maybe this limited edition pair? Ah, these feel pretty right. They match my outfit today.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Eh, let's go with the first ones after all.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: (Rolls eyes)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Missy, perfect timing. Which pair do you think looks best?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Don't ask. Every part of you looks awful to me right now.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's wrong? You're in a rotten mood. Special day today?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ngaang gau ah, nei!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You were pounding on my door at dawn for this?! So I could watch you count SHOES? You've collected a billion pairs that all look basically the same to me!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: How are they the same? They're all different editions, the materials are all different... ugh, what am I doing telling you this.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Our dorms are next to each other. We're like neighbors. We help each other out.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Like I care about you!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Let me make this clear to you, today is my day off! It's three minutes to six right now, and if I sound this alarm, I can write you up for disturbing the peace!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You want overtime? Fine! Do it yourself! You're gonna lose your hair working 24/7, but don't try to take my locks too!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Overtime nothing. Not often we get a day off, and the L.G.D. doesn't pay much more for overtime. They're pretty tight-pursed. I'm no workaholic like Ch'en either.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: And Missy, are you one to talk? Didn't you just come back from the L.G.D.? I heard you opening and slamming the door. That one traveled.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Piss off! I'm so done right now!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Our plate's loaded! We've got the mess Reunion left, we've got business with that stinky old rat... and that puk gaai Lung isn't even here when it matters. What DOESN'T need doing?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You got promoted, and they want you transferred? Transferred where? Are we just going to give the Special Inspection Unit to someone else?!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I've had it up to HERE!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Calm down, calm down. It's not like Mr. Wei hasn't thought it through. He's training you.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: For when the L.G.D. is your responsibility. If you ask me, it's just a matter of time.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You can do it.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: You... you don't need to tell me! Of course I know that already!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: B—But she was supposed to take over the L.G.D... She was groomed for it...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: *Sigh*. Don't you go crying again.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Who's crying?!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Just you wait. Who cares if some smelly dragon never comes back. Sooner or later I'll seize the L.G.D. for myself. All of it, just you wait.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ha ha, now that's something to look forward to.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Ugh. No, wait. Did you just say you heard me opening the door when I came back? So you knew I hadn't slept all night?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Then why the hell did you still call me over? You said you didn't do it on purpose!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, hey, don't get worked up.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I was worried you were pushing yourself too hard. Been a lot happening lately, and we haven't really gotten the chance to meet up, right?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Here, I bet you skipped breakfast again, right? I bought some breakfast. It's your favorite chow fun. Eat a little before you go to sleep.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hmph. Didn't ask you to.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Fine, fine, you didn't ask me to. Will you still eat it?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Of course I will! Give it!

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Hey, why'd you buy two portions? How am I gonna finish this much?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh... that was two? Must've been habit. Bought them without thinking.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Three-mushroom shredded fowl, saa sin sauce, extra starchroot... Hmph, only that dummy would like it this way.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Their place uses pretty boring noodles. The flavor's too bland, they skimp on the ingredients. It's barely passable. Next time, remember: go downstairs from the L.G.D., turn the corner, second house down with the blue sign hung outside. They do better stuff.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Fine, I get it, I'll get you theirs next time. Just try and eat some for now. Woah, slow down! You don't have to inhale it.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: (Yawn)

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Oh, yeah, where are you going today? I'm up already, so you may as well count me in for some window-shopping.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: I need to go buy that one Svrrovski piece. The new one from the JOKER series. It came out just last week.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, the one Ch'en's had her eye on since forever ago?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Yep, that one. She's got a pretty good eye for those. She's better at picking out clothes and jewelry than I am.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Sounds like a compliment to me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Personally, I don't even get to wear that kinda jewelry much after I buy it. Good thing she gets paid enough, and she lives in a free L.G.D. dorm. She'd be in dire straits otherwise.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Anyway, Missy, you're inviting me? That's pretty rare. Is this the first time ever?

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: If I had anyone else, you think I'd wanna pick you?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I guess so. Whoa, actually, if I don't head out now I'll be late. Later.

steps.name: Swire
steps.text: Wait, going where? Hold on, I'm gonna do my makeup!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't. You're plenty fine even without making up, 'Miss.'

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Thanks for inviting me, but I'll have to pass today. I'm just going out for a spin, not much point in tagging along. I'll pick you up next time.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Get some sleep. Leave those bags under your eyes for too long, and it'll be rough when you finally wanna get them off.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You need more rest, Swire, you really do.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Madame, good morning!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Morning. You've all worked enough. Want some breakfast? I got recommended a place, so I picked some up along the way.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Seriously, this early on a vacation day and I still see so many people in this building.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Ever since that whole incident, it's been like this non-stop, ugh.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Same goes for you, Madame Hoshiguma. You only left a few hours ago and now you're back. You're off today, if I remember?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No comparison. Things are different for me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Forget that, are you really still okay? I feel like you're wobbling... Eat something, and lie down in the lounge for a bit. Lay off the energy drinks. They're not good for you.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Ah, thank you, Madame. But I'm okay. Once I'm done with the work I've got on hand, I can go home and sleep.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: (Yawn)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Fine. I won't say much more then. Just mind yourself.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's been all hands on deck lately. After we're past this, I'll take you all out for a feast.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: A feast? I'll pass. What I want is a raise.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Two days ago I ran into the guy from that Rhodes Island office, flaunting his promotion in front of me... pah, what's to flaunt? You just get a few more vacation days than I do...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: ...Rhodes Island?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: The ones who worked with us? And the lot who took Madame Ch'en away?!

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: I thought those guys scrammed ages ago!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah... you mean that local branch of theirs, right?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I think they do some recruitment too. Weren't there a few youngsters making trouble in the streets who got talked into picking up some work instead?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They've got a way with words.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Don't you go stirring trouble for them. It's all Lungmen citizens working in that office. No picking bones.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Go back and tell the kiddos downstairs too. No getting mixed up.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: The hell I can. Everyone's clear deep down.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Us and Rhodes Island get along fine enough. Once in a blue moon we'll have drinks together.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: They've got plenty of weirdos there, and besides their local office people, you pass by them now and again on the street. Some just look wild. We can't help but stare a bit.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Last week they had some kind of Laterano monastery girl with them... and not to mention they can all hold their liquor.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Huh?! So the time you came back dead drunk, it was Rhodes who got you like that?! You threw up all over me!

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Uh... did that happen?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Damn right it did!

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Fine, fine, my bad. Next time you file for a day off to go on a date with your girlfriend, I'll approve it, okay?

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Just hang in there until this bump's over, and every district we're rebuilding has its reconstruction schedules all sorted out. Then we'll be good.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Of course I know that... Honestly, though, once this bump's over, I'm probably not gonna have a girlfriend anymore... *sigh*.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Hey, that works out. Won't need to approve your day off.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Brutal. If you don't have anything nice to say...

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: He's just like that. I'm used to it.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Brat.

steps.name: Exhausted L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Anyway, Madame, same to you. It's your day off. Don't hang around here, go on back and take a break pronto.

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: Yeah, just leave things here to us!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Oh, looks like I'm not that popular. Or is there another reason you're trying to shoo me out here?

steps.name: L.G.D. Officer
steps.text: N-No, that's not what I mean...!

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ha ha, alright, relax, I'm joking. I just came in to have a look, and drop off some food on the side.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Here, chow fun. You get to it, then. I'm leaving.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Whew, I'm tired.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I've only been up for a few days, and I'm already starting to buckle. Getting off-kilter.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm not getting old, right? Shouldn't be, I'm still young if I think about it hard enough...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Maybe I am?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ha, whatever...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, partner, what do you think? It's been a while since I gave you some exercise. Let's head out to that racetrack in Ngai Kang and give it a spin, feel the breeze.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hey, your exhaust sounds a little off today. Don't tell me you're getting old too?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: No, of course not, you're definitely still latest model. 70vv.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Though I guess a model even newer than you just came out. Steady and smooth, fast as lightning. Their ads have always been pretty good, haven't they?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I still wanna get my hands on one to try, but they break the bank. It's okay, partner, we'll put up with each other for a bit. My wages aren't that high. Can't always spend like I did on you.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're far from out of date, and I'm far from retirement. We match pretty well, don't we?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What's your opinion? What makes Ch'en so hard to crack?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Think she can get used to Rhodes Island? Is she gonna get into fights? I'm guessing so. It's not like she can't get along with people, it's just if she's not willing...
Nay.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: —Who's there!?

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Miss Ch'en is no fossilized bonehead.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Nor blindly headstrong.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah, who's there? You're... Lady Shirayuki.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Madame Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I don't need the title. How come you're here, Lady Shirayuki?

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: The Madam is away. My orders, to protect thee.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Got it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Lady Shirayuki, I heard the Madam recently assigned you to Rhodes Island?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: How is it? Is little Amiya still holding up? And the Doctor by her side... I remember that one sticking behind cover giving orders. Freakishly smart, freakishly tired. How are they all now?

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: In plentiful vigor, spirits held high.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Raucous blather.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Loud sort.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ha ha ha ha, sounds like they're still full of beans.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It seems like you have a pretty nice impression of Rhodes Island, Lady Shirayuki.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Truly, Rhodes Island is agreeable.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: As goes for Miss Ch'en.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: ...Thou needn't dwell.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: What, so now even Lady Shirayuki's saying it... You're not telling me I've got worry written across my entire face? Seriously?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That can't be right. If I was like that, Missy would've torn a layer off my face this morning.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It's okay, Lady Shirayuki. I'm not worried about Ch'en, that's the truth.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Truest truth. Don't judge Ch'en by her cover. Sure, she'll snap like whiplash, but she's got a delicate heart in there.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I didn't see it coming when I first met her all the way back. Only came to realize after being with her a lot more. I believe as long as she has a brick wall to bash her head against, she'll live decent no matter where it is.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Intelligent and sharp-witted is Miss Ch'en.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Tongue incisive, and her action ne'er pales.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: The commonfolk cannot hope to cheat her.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ha ha, true that.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Tell me, where do you find someone like her? Piss her off and she'll switch to chewing people out, and as long as there's reason, she'll chew out anyone. I've never seen her scared before.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Miss Ch'en... is unreserved.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Honestly, Ch'en's temper hasn't changed once in all these years.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I've always felt she put a lot of stress on chivalry. In those manga about master swordsmen, her sort would be the main character.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But, you know, blood and gore's fun enough to read about, but having those wounds on your own body really aches something fierce.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: There are times I see her aching beyond help, and I think, is it really worth this?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: It isn't worth it. In truth, in full honesty, I feel it truly isn't worth it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But she thinks it is.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm not worried if she comes to grief. A little grief is no bad thing. Get too strong-willed and you'll come to a lot worse.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm just scared that she can't get over it. That she can't let it go.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Miss Ch'en's soul is wide.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Rid of her chest's weight, she is ever more unstoppable.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You see clearly, Lady Shirayuki. And Master Wei and the Madam see even more plainly.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: You too, Madame Hoshiguma, are chivalrous.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Me? Stop it, that's over the top now. I'm clear when it comes to myself.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: When I was young, I didn't know how things worked. I dreamed, of course, too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I've done a lot of impulsive things, and it's not like I've never had some hot blood in me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: But the hot-blooded story's over, the kid's no longer a kid, and now what? They wouldn't write this stuff in a story. Write it and the readers'd get mad. Total waste of effort. Save yourself the trouble of ever writing it.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Stories get to end at the best possible times. Life doesn't.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If chivalry looked like me, carrying the weight of the world, then people wouldn't be into it.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: One cannot undervalue oneself.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: If you may see this.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: This is... a comic?

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Tai Kam Road, Second Lane bookstore. This month's new publication.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: A present for thee.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Really unexpected.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Much thanks. Though I'm surprised. You read this, Lady Shirayuki?

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Madame will know at a gloss.

steps.name: Shirayuki
steps.text: Then. I, Shirayuki, take my leave.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (This series...)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (A new artist's debut work. Second overall in readers' support, and other artists have been recommending it...)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (It seems pretty decent, too. Is this the protagonist on the cover?)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Kinda... familiar...)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (This big one holding the shield is...)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Ah, ha. So that's how it is. No wonder.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: They've got some guts. But they still know their work. Art's not bad, too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Whatever. What—ever...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: If I ever see Ch'en again, what should I call her?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Operator Ch'en?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Hm...

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Pretty good. Pretty fitting, too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Still not fast enough.)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Got a curve up ahead. Perfect, I can still kick up a gear.)
The one-horned Oni lets out her breath.
It's been a long time since she sped through the wind so savagely. With every roar her beloved machine lets out beneath her, her young, brazen blood seems to flow again, in speed for its own sake.
—Until suddenly, behind her, sounds another mechanical beast's cries.
The L.G.D.'s Madame Hoshiguma comes back to her senses.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Mm?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Who is it...?)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (The sound's coming from behind, and getting closer.)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Pretty good speed, catching up to me.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Heh, that model and that engine's sound. It's the latest one in the ads. Odds are it's modified, too.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Let's burn some rubber, partner. We can't lose.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Strange. When was there someone so good, and how did I never know?)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (And they kind of seem like...)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ('Tearing the vacant streets in the dead of night, the ghost driver in the flashes on the winding roads.')

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: (Wait, but the vehicle's not right. And I think I know who's driving it..)

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...No way?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: ...Phew.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're good. It's my loss.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: I'm flattered. You took that curve very well. Had my machine not been somewhat better, I would never have overtaken.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Good morning, Inspector Hoshiguma.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: You're unbeatable, Madam Fumizuki.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Oh, my. You don't seem surprised at all.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I'm pretty surprised, actually. It was too fast just before. I only dared to guess it was you after that curve.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Everyone's familiar with your principal vehicle, Madam, I'd never mistake it. Today's the first time I've seen those wheels, though.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Are you going to issue me a speeding ticket, then?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Of course I couldn't. This racecourse is outside our jurisdiction, anyway, specifically for racing... If tickets were a thing out here, I wouldn't get away with it either.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Hehe. You've all been working terribly hard.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: That's our job. Nothing terrible about it.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: What's wrong, Inspector Hoshiguma? You seem like there's still something you want to say.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Eh... nothing much.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Just thinking, the wind out here feels really nice.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Flooring down an accelerator sure does wonders for my mood.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Quite right. Hear, hear!

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: In times with just too much to try and do, it truly feels a lot better once you've taken in the breeze.

steps.name: Fumizuki
steps.text: Though that can't be all you wanted to say, can it?

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: Huh... I guess there's no hiding it from you, Madam.

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: I was just thinking—

steps.name: Hoshiguma
steps.text: The Stream-35LL Luminous Luxury parked downstairs from Master Wei for the last two days, even though he doesn't seem like the biking type. Sure enough, it was never his.
